sentences.text: A study of galacto-oligosaccharides reported that this prebiotic enriched specific Lachnospiraceae species, among them Oliverpabstia intestinalis.
In a dietary intervention study, Oliverpabstia was reported among taxa within the family Lachnospiraceae that were depleted after the intervention.
A lifestyle intervention study reported increased levels of several genera described as butyrate-producing and anti-inflammatory, including Oliverpabstia.
